title: The Orbital Solarium Scrip
logline: Trapped maintenance workers at a luxury coronal radiation spa are paid in worthless scrip while management hides cracked cuprite heat sinks that threaten a meltdown.

roles.description: Runs the elite coronal sunbathing retreat; polished, ruthless, drowning staff in company-store debt.
Senior life-support engineer on the habitat; coughing from ozone, desperate to save his apprentice crew.
A federation of service and maintenance laborers organizing across frontier stations.
A luxury observation habitat hovering in close solar orbit, offering therapeutic coronal views.
A working-class transport station where labour magistrates hear contract disputes.
A heavy foundry depot producing radiation baffles and heat exchanger assemblies.

public_situation: The premier solar retreat in {system} advertises sold-out coronal wellness suites, even as maintenance crews report chronic life-support power flickers.
private_truth: {role:solarium_manager} is paying habitat workers in non-convertible resort scrip while concealing cracked cuprite heat sinks to keep booking VIP radiation tourists.

beats.public_change: The solarium engineering bay posts an urgent procurement contract for high-purity cuprite ore.

missions.reason: He needs raw cuprite ore delivered directly to habitat fabrication bays to cast emergency heat dissipation shunts.
missions.private_fact: The station's secondary thermal radiators will melt through during the next solar flare without conductive cuprite alloy.

beats.public_change: Station management issues an inspection contract to confirm that outer radiation levels comply with marketing guidelines.

missions.reason: The manager hires the pilot to scan exterior heat exchanger fins and certify that flare exposure remains within certified spa parameters.
missions.private_fact: He has already bribed regional tourism inspectors to ignore ionizing radiation spikes leaking into worker quarters.

beats.public_change: Ozone alarms sound across the habitat's lower engineering decks as solar activity surges.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to purchase factory-grade cooling coils from an industrial foundry to bypass the manager's locked supply vault.
missions.private_fact: He drained his private life savings in legitimate credits to pay for the coils after the manager refused to spend resort funds.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot delivers the coils. {role:solarium_manager} offers a massive executive bonus to conceal the near-meltdown, while {role:solarium_mechanic} begs to send evidence to the union.

options.label: Take the manager's hush bonus and keep quiet
Courier the unedited radiation logs to the trade union

beats.public_change: The workers union convenes an emergency tribunal at the regional dock to review habitat telemetry.

missions.reason: He contracts the pilot to carry sealed telemetry slates and scrip wage ledgers to union magistrates before the manager can delete them.
missions.private_fact: The evidence proves the manager deducted life-support breathing charges from worker wages while venting irradiated gas into their bunks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the evidence to the union, triggering an immediate shutdown and evacuation of the solarium.
resolutions.summary: {role:hospitality_workers_union} shuts down {role:orbital_solarium_hub}. Trapped staff are evacuated to safety, and {role:solarium_manager} faces trial.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot hauled the radiation logs that freed an exploited engineering crew from a solar resort.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the manager's bribe or loses the union dossier.
resolutions.summary: {role:solarium_manager} patches the radiators quietly and continues issuing scrip. {role:solarium_mechanic} is placed on unpaid suspension.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fakes the readings or fails to deliver the replacement cooling coils.
resolutions.summary: The coronal flare burns through the unshielded habitat. Guests and workers suffer radiation poisoning, and the station is permanently abandoned.

loose_threads.detail: The solarium payroll tokens are minted on low-purity ferrite blanks with no legal bullion backing.
All local futures contracts for cuprite radiator coils were bought out by an anonymous corporate broker.
A maintenance engineer's personnel file was flagged with an internal sabotage code three weeks before the flare.

radio_hooks: Sunbathing suites at {role:orbital_solarium_hub} report record occupancy ahead of projected stellar flare.
Union organizers demand independent safety inspection of high-radiation habitats in {system}.
Hospitality scrip trading at heavy discount on unregulated border station exchanges.

voice_direction.solarium_manager: Soothing, modulated hospitality tones that never waver. Treats lethal ionizing radiation as a marketing feature and shrugs off worker grievances.
voice_direction.solarium_mechanic: Hoarse, exhausted, and urgent. Rattles off coolant temperature limits and core decay rates like someone reciting a will.
